name: The Cultural Soul
description: Seamless border-crossing trails through the subcontinent's sacred and scenic core.

sub_destinations.name: India
sub_destinations.desc: A Ganges sunrise in Varanasi, and a thali that's a different meal in every state you cross.

sub_destinations.name: Nepal
sub_destinations.desc: A sunrise flight past Everest's south face, and a Kathmandu backstreet temple older than most countries.

sub_destinations.name: Bhutan
sub_destinations.desc: Tiger's Nest clinging to a cliff face, and a kingdom that measures progress in happiness and means it.

sub_destinations.name: Sri Lanka
sub_destinations.desc: A train through tea country with the door left open, and beaches that haven't made it onto anyone's feed yet.

name: Once-in-a-Lifetime
description: Bucket-list journeys built for travelers who plan years, not weekends, ahead.

sub_destinations.name: Scandinavia
sub_destinations.desc: Fjords carved by glaciers, and cities that shut down for the midnight sun.

sub_destinations.name: New Zealand
sub_destinations.desc: Glaciers, geysers, and a drive where every turn is the postcard.

sub_destinations.name: Australia
sub_destinations.desc: Reef to red desert on one itinerary, and a coastline longer than most countries' borders.

sub_destinations.name: South Korea
sub_destinations.desc: Palace rooftops against glass towers, and street food stalls that stay open past the last subway.

name: Glowcations & Honeymoons
description: Pure isolation or culture-plus-luxury, curated for couples and wellness escapes.

sub_destinations.name: Maldives
sub_destinations.desc: A bungalow with the ocean floor visible through your own floorboards.

sub_destinations.name: Seychelles
sub_destinations.desc: Granite boulders older than the dinosaurs, framing a beach with nobody else on it.

sub_destinations.name: Mauritius
sub_destinations.desc: A lagoon calm enough to read in, and a Creole kitchen that's the actual reason to come back.

sub_destinations.name: Bali
sub_destinations.desc: Rice terraces before the tour buses, and a temple ceremony that isn't staged for anyone.

name: Family & MICE Sailings
description: The volume engine — European river cruising and large-liner departures across Asia.

sub_destinations.name: European River Cruise
sub_destinations.desc: A different country through your cabin window every morning, and no luggage to repack in between.

sub_destinations.name: Royal Caribbean
sub_destinations.desc: A different island every other day, and a ship big enough to forget you're at sea.

sub_destinations.name: Resorts World
sub_destinations.desc: One check-in, and a week where nobody asks you to decide anything.
